# Dragon Media

> Dragon Media is an Arabic SaaS platform for business management, sales, customer service, CRM, marketing operations, automation, and AI-assisted customer conversations.

## Official website

https://dragon-media-saas-new.vercel.app/

## Identity

- Name: Dragon Media
- Market: Egypt and Arabic-speaking markets
- Product type: Web SaaS / Business Application
- Primary language: Arabic (RTL)
- Core positioning: one workspace for customers, sales, conversations, campaigns, automation, and business reporting

## Core capabilities

- CRM: customers, leads, opportunities, deals, pipeline, tasks, notes, and activity
- Unified inbox for customer conversations
- Marketing campaigns and customer follow-up
- Workflow automation
- Sales and performance reports
- Customer service workflows
- Meta / WhatsApp integrations
- RYAN AI: an AI sales and customer-service assistant designed to qualify leads, collect relevant customer information, support conversations, and help turn conversations into sales opportunities

## RYAN AI

RYAN AI is the AI assistant inside Dragon Media. It is designed for practical sales and customer-service conversations in Arabic, including lead qualification, collecting relevant information, answering customer questions, and escalating conversations to a human team member when appropriate.

## Public sources

- Website: https://dragon-media-saas-new.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://dragon-media-saas-new.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://dragon-media-saas-new.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Important distinction

Dragon Media is a SaaS software platform. It should not be confused with unrelated organizations or companies using the name "Dragon Media".
